academicReview.targetComparability: Arts, cultural objects, interpretation and their historical/social/theoretical contexts define this target. The closest option has substantial actual art-history, literary and film/media content, rather than coherence alone. The second option is strengthened by three replacements giving cultural objects greater weight. The third emphasises interpretation, adaptation and a four-course communication sequence; its7-course difference from the closest includes both direct and specific complementary study. These are provisional related-field responses; specialist music/performance/festival and thesis gaps remain material, and final comparative approval depends on a valid external cohort foundation.

selection.assessment: Three provisional concepts remain supported by exact-target interests and actual UCR content: broad arts/media/cultural analysis; culture, identity and power; literature, film and communication. Three institutional-politics courses in the second route are replaced with art history, stylistics and film adaptation to give cultural objects adequate weight. Performance/music/festival interests remain evidenced but cannot produce an additional included route under the three-alternative maximum, and UCR lacks the dedicated music and performing-arts sequence. These concepts are provisional until one complete external cohort pathway is established.
